label: token a as the first or second input
explanation: Fires only when the input token is "a" at step 0 or step 1 of the original phase. Every such step activates and essentially nothing else does. Magnitude is greatest at t=0, where it always reaches the max of 0.824. At t=1 it is lower and varies with the preceding token, roughly 0.52 to 0.70 (0.63 to 0.85 of max); an "a" following an initial "a" sits at about 0.83 of max. It never fires on "a" at step 3 or later, on any other token, or anywhere in the delimiter or copy phases. The one exception is 51 very weak activations (about 0.05 of max) on "a" at t=2 when the first token is "c"; these carry under 0.01% of the activation mass.

issues: Minor imprecision: the t=2 exception is only about 9% of 'a at t=2 after first token c' (51 of 552 dev steps). The misses show the second token is also specific (c, q, y), so 'when the first token is c' overstates how broad the exception is. The rest of the explanation is unaffected: these steps hold about 0.01% of the activation mass.

I did not check the exact t=1 magnitude range (0.63 to 0.85 of max) directly. It is consistent with the profile: t=1 holds 41% of the mass from about the same number of steps as t=0 (59%), and the median activation equals the max of 0.824.

Every other claim checks out on dev and test. Activity is limited to the original phase, with zero activations in the delimiter or copy phases. Only token 'a' ever fires. Activity is limited to t<=2, and t=2 has only 51 activations. Test split: precision 1.0, recall 0.998, F1 0.999, mass recall 0.9999, 0 false positives, and the 53 misses are all weak (0.05 to 0.07 of max) 'a' at t=2 after a first token of c.
